== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns John Williamson. The printed Edinburgh marriage register records Alison Glasgow with John Williamson, cordiner, on 14 November 1672.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 685 / 1/440 / 139; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record]; Henry Paton, ed., Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700 (Scottish Record Society, 1905), printed pp.267 and 741; PDF pp.277 and 751; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=751 record]; Same edition, unnumbered Prefatory Note, PDF p.9; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=9 record].</ref> The printed transcription and its preface were visually inspected on 30 September 2026; original parish image unchecked. The identification remains uncertain.
